mainEntity.name: What is included in a barndominium shell construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: A barndominium shell includes the complete structural exterior of the building. This typically consists of the concrete foundation, steel or post-frame structural framing, exterior metal siding, roofing, rough openings, and exterior doors or windows. It does not include interior framing, drywall, plumbing, electrical wiring, or climate control. Choosing a shell build allows property owners to secure a weather-tight structure immediately, leaving the interior buildout to be completed in phases or by specialized trades later.
acceptedAnswer.description: A barndominium shell includes the concrete foundation, structural framing, exterior siding, roof, and exterior doors or windows to create a weather-tight building.
